decisions.decision: Add `-D warnings` to the features workflow environment.
decisions.rationale: Both `verify.yml` and `features.yml` catch mismatched `#[cfg]` defects; without `-D warnings`, `features.yml` permitted these defects to pass as unread warnings.
decisions.quote: verify.yml set it and features.yml did not, while the two exist to catch the same defect: a #[cfg] that does not match what the code needs. This workflow has caught six of those by build failure and let the identical defect through as a warning nobody read.

decisions.decision: Gate six previously ungated items with feature attributes rather than suppressions.
decisions.rationale: The items were imported or defined without declaring their feature dependencies, producing unused warnings in specific feature builds.
decisions.quote: Every fix is an attribute, not a suppression.

decisions.decision: Separate the missing release failure into distinct messages based on gh authentication.
decisions.rationale: The previous single diagnostic covered two different failure conditions with different remedies, leaving users to guess the cause when unauthenticated.
decisions.quote: Two conditions with different remedies now get two messages, which is the shape D-A24 catalogued.

prerequisites.text: The backend guard must remain the first error line for the refused job's checks to hold.
prerequisites.quote: the backend guard is still the first error line, which is the property that job defends

prerequisites.text: All five library crates already compile without warnings across feature builds.
prerequisites.quote: The five libraries were already clean

prerequisites.text: years_quantity is only called when either the events or cosmo features are active.
prerequisites.quote: years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends

prerequisites.text: parse_form and codec::Form belong exclusively to run_now, which requires both civil and std.
prerequisites.quote: parse_form and codec::Form belong to run_now, which needs civil and std.

alternatives.reason: The author resolved the unused warnings by gating items to their actual feature dependencies rather than silencing the warnings.
alternatives.quote: Every fix is an attribute, not a suppression.

consequences.text: The refused job inherits -D warnings and its checks still hold.
consequences.quote: The refused job inherits the flag and its checks still hold — the backend guard is still the first error line
consequences.verification_quote: the backend guard is still the first error line, which is the property that job defends and the one -D warnings could most easily have broken.

consequences.text: Warnings across eight of the nineteen builds in the binary crate surfaced one layer at a time.
consequences.quote: all of it was in the binary crate, in eight of the nineteen builds, and it surfaced one layer at a time because a lib that fails to compile never lets the binary's own warnings appear.

consequences.text: Two distinct failure conditions with different remedies now each receive an explicit message.
consequences.quote: Two conditions with different remedies now get two messages, which is the shape D-A24 catalogued.
